        About this item

        • Compatibility: only for iPhone Air/17/17e/16/15/14/13/12 series, Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra/S26+/S26/S25 Ultra/S25 +/S25 with a magnetic case; for optimal charging, use the cable provided with a USB-C to C charger of ≥ 20W；recommended to use with official or ESR magnetic cases; not compatible with Motorola, OnePlus, and Google phones
        • Fast Charging: 15W MagSafe iPhone charging gives you safer, more reliable charging at faster speeds
        • Secure Magnetic Lock: powerful ring of magnets with 1,600 g of holding force keeps your phone securely in place, even on bumpy roads; an official MagSafe case or ESR magnetic case is recommended for rough terrain
        • Mount Your Way: choose to mount on your car’s air vent or dashboard; strong vent mount and high-quality adhesive provide enhanced mounting stability
        • Ready for Navigation: switch between portrait and landscape for easy navigation
        • What‘s Included: MagSafe Car Mount Charger, air vent clip, dashboard anchor, 3.3-ft (1 m) C to USB C cable, and manual; ⚠️ car charging adapter not included;
        • Complete Customer Support: detailed setup videos, FAQs, a comprehensive 12-month protection plan, unlimited support, and personalized help

          • RS
            5 out of 5 stars
            Outstanding Quality and Versatile Performance
            Reviewed in Canada on 15 November 2024
            Style Name: 15W-Air Vent Wireless Car Charger
            Verified Purchase
            Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
            Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

            The ESR CAR Vent MagSafe Charger is overall a fantastic product. It’s sturdy, stable, and keeps my phone secure even on bumpy roads. The quick charging feature is excellent—charging my phone rapidly with minimal or no heating, which is perfect for long drives.

            I appreciate its flexibility, as it can be placed on either vent, including the passenger side, and the 360-degree rotation makes adjusting the viewing angle effortless. However, I do wish there were some metal components to reinforce the build. The plastic parts that attach to the vents are fine, but a bit of metal would ensure they don’t warp over time.

            Overall, it’s a solid and reliable charger with room for a little improvement in durability. Highly recommend for its performance and functionality

          About this Item

          • Compatibility: only for iPhone Air/17/17e/16/15/14/13/12 series, Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra/S26+/S26/S25 Ultra/S25 +/S25 with a magnetic case; for optimal charging, use the cable provided with a USB-C to C charger of ≥ 20W；recommended to use with official or ESR magnetic cases; not compatible with Motorola, OnePlus, and Google phones
          • Fast Charging: 15W MagSafe iPhone charging gives you safer, more reliable charging at faster speeds
          • Secure Magnetic Lock: powerful ring of magnets with 1,600 g of holding force keeps your phone securely in place, even on bumpy roads; an official MagSafe case or ESR magnetic case is recommended for rough terrain
          • Mount Your Way: choose to mount on your car’s air vent or dashboard; strong vent mount and high-quality adhesive provide enhanced mounting stability
          • Ready for Navigation: switch between portrait and landscape for easy navigation
          • What‘s Included: MagSafe Car Mount Charger, air vent clip, dashboard anchor, 3.3-ft (1 m) C to USB C cable, and manual; ⚠️ car charging adapter not included;
          • Complete Customer Support: detailed setup videos, FAQs, a comprehensive 12-month protection plan, unlimited support, and personalized help
